description: This file defines the MergeIntoWriter class and related nested classes for performing merge operations in PySpark SQL, including methods for matching, inserting, updating, and deleting rows based on specified conditions.

classes.name: MergeIntoWriter
classes.description: Provides methods to define and execute merge actions based on specified conditions.

classes.name: MergeIntoWriter.WhenMatched
classes.description: Defines actions to take when rows match during a merge operation.

classes.name: MergeIntoWriter.WhenNotMatched
classes.description: Defines actions to take when no matching rows are found during a merge operation.

classes.name: MergeIntoWriter.WhenNotMatchedBySource
classes.description: Defines actions to take when target rows do not match any source rows during a merge.

methods.name: MergeIntoWriter.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the merge writer with a DataFrame, target table, and merge condition.

methods.name: MergeIntoWriter.whenMatched
methods.description: Starts defining actions for matched rows with an optional condition.

methods.name: MergeIntoWriter.whenNotMatched
methods.description: Starts defining actions for not matched rows with an optional condition.

methods.name: MergeIntoWriter.whenNotMatchedBySource
methods.description: Starts defining actions for target rows with no matching source rows.

methods.name: MergeIntoWriter.withSchemaEvolution
methods.description: Enables automatic schema evolution for the merge operation.
